newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS START OF 2ND ENGLAND-NZ TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS START OF 2ND ENGLAND-NZ TEST.

text.p: Rain delayed the start of the second cricket test between New Zealand and England on Thursday.
Athough the weather had cleared after torrential rain overnight, showers were forecast and the outfield was soaked.
The umpires said that lunch would be taken at the usual time and they would make their first pitch inspection at 1.00 p.m. (0000 GMT).
The first test in the three-match series was drawn.
